title: A Jupiter-mass companion to a solar-type star
numerical_result: The paper reported a 4.23-day velocity signal interpreted as a companion with minimum mass about 0.47 Jupiter masses
remaining_question: Historical inference should be read with later confirmation and modern stellar-activity tests

title: ELODIE a spectrograph for accurate radial velocity measurements
what_was_studied: Fibre-fed spectrograph, online reduction and cross-correlation performance
numerical_result: ELODIE covered 390.6 to 681.1 nm at resolving power about 42000 and reported accuracy better than 15 m/s for suitable bright stars
remaining_question: How do mask choice and spectral type change the delivered error distribution?

title: The ELODIE survey for northern extrasolar planets
what_was_studied: Long-running northern-hemisphere planet-search programme and automatic cross-correlation velocities
numerical_result: The survey used ELODIE on the OHP 1.93 m and reported candidate orbital solutions from repeated measurements
remaining_question: Long-period solutions require careful treatment of cadence and stellar activity

title: SOPHIE echelle spectrograph
what_was_studied: Successor instrument and transition from ELODIE
numerical_result: OHP states that SOPHIE replaced ELODIE on the 1.93 m telescope in 2006
remaining_question: A specific dated ELODIE retirement notice is still absent from this ledger
